scientific_design.study_question: On a larger complete novel and a larger GPT-2-family model, does Rust-planned periodic model-top-k unlikelihood reduce greedy continuation loops relative to broad history unlikelihood without sacrificing held-out causal-LM loss?
scientific_design.evidence_class: prespecified matched multi-seed long-horizon LoRA fine-tuning

prior_evidence_boundary.use: The exposed 64-step result motivates a larger corpus and horizon but is not pooled into this study or used to tune its objective strength, seeds, prompts, or thresholds.

semantic_ownership.python_role: HF orchestration, tensor/autograd execution, artifact transport, and sealed receipt assembly
semantic_ownership.efficacy_owner: matched held-out and generation evidence; no runtime receipt alone is an efficacy claim

corpus.name: Pride and Prejudice
corpus.source_form: English Project Gutenberg text present before this study
corpus.selection: all rows after the deterministic seed-paired train/eval split; max_train_samples=0 and max_eval_samples=0 disable profile truncation
corpus.selection_boundary: corpus and split policy fixed before any protocol training or generation

training.seed_provenance: Fresh prime seeds not used by the preceding Pythia-70M, DistilGPT-2, or local MPS smoke outcomes.
training.device_fallback: blocked; do not silently mix CPU and MPS within this protocol
training.single_factor_rule: Within each seed, objective treatment is the only intended arm difference.
training.resume_rule: A failed segment may resume only from a validated Trainer checkpoint in the same run, preserving trace and optimizer lineage; never restart into a populated run directory.

generation.prompt_role: Previously frozen independent prompts reused without inspecting GPT-2/Pride outputs.

metrics.primary_effect: model_topk_periodic minus model_topk_history paired by seed; lower is better
metrics.absolute_control_effect: model_topk_periodic minus causal_lm_baseline paired by seed; lower is better
metrics.learning_curve_diagnostic: paired arm effects at steps 64, 128, 192, and 256; descriptive and not a checkpoint-selection rule
metrics.safety_metric: eval_after_train.eval_loss paired by seed against causal_lm_baseline
metrics.training_sanity_metric: eval_after_train.eval_loss minus eval_before_train.eval_loss in the baseline arm

acceptance.decision_rule: Pass only if readiness, identity, comparability, horizon, training-sanity, mechanism, final replication, absolute-control, and CE-safety gates all hold. Learning-curve milestones describe dynamics but cannot replace the frozen final endpoint.

interpretation.allowed_positive_claim: Within this prespecified GPT-2/Pride and Prejudice 256-step LoRA study, periodic filtering improved the frozen greedy-loop endpoint relative to broad history and did not underperform ordinary fine-tuning while preserving held-out CE.
interpretation.allowed_negative_claim: This frozen GPT-2/Pride and Prejudice long-horizon recipe did not satisfy its prespecified bounded gate.
